scope: Scoped kitchen fitting and live-water visual review; not whole-world photorealism or owner acceptance.

images.observation: Compact bowl and retained drainboard now sit on a source-sized frame; old over-wide stand removed.
Compact rolled lip sits on the pierced timber-counter worktop; existing dish stock retained.
Curved nickel faucet, separate marked valve caps and a stream aligned to the downward mouth. Room reflections give the nickel a blue cast.
Upper standard bowl and board retain their frame and receive connecting bearings beneath the rim.
